pipelinq-portal.title: Pipelinq Portal
pipelinq-portal.description: Separate auth-domain register for the customer self-service portal (ADR-005). Holds portal accounts, sessions, delegations, audit events and tenant configuration. Strictly isolated from Nextcloud users and from the main pipelinq register.

portalAccount.title: Portal Account
portalAccount.summary: A customer self-service portal credential record (pipelinq-owned sync state for the linked contact).
portalAccount.description: Identity-bearing credential for the customer portal. The customer's real identity is the linked contact entity; this record only carries portal-session credential state (password hash, MFA secret, status). Never stores plaintext secrets.

portalSession.title: Portal Session
portalSession.summary: An authenticated portal session bound to a portal account.
portalSession.description: Holds the SHA-256 hash of the session token (never the plaintext), expiry, and revocation state. Tokens are 256-bit random values shown once at login.

portalDelegation.title: Portal Delegation
portalDelegation.summary: A B2B scope grant from one portal account to another.
portalDelegation.description: Grants a colleague account a subset of scopes (view-invoices, view-contracts, submit-requests) over the granter's organisation data, time-bounded and revocable.

portalAuditEvent.title: Portal Audit Event
portalAuditEvent.summary: An append-only audit record of a sensitive portal action.
portalAuditEvent.description: Immutable once written (no updates, no deletes). Supports AVG Art. 15 export and DPO compliance audits.
